summary.text: Lindsey Burke is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 75 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney and the founder of Micah Legal.

paragraphs.text: Lindsey Burke earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Florida State University in 2007, a master's degree in social service administration from the University of Chicago in 2012, and a law degree from the University of Cincinnati in 2015.

Her career experience includes founding Micah Legal and working as one of its attorneys, clerking with Legal Aid of the Bluegrass and Legal Aid Society of Greater Cincinnati, and serving as a graduate organizing intern with the Illinois chapter of the National Association of Social Workers.
Burke has served on the board of Central Christian Church Apartments, Inc., on the Sullivan University Legal Advisory Board, and as a mentor with the New Leaders Council.
Burke took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kelly Flood.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Committee on Committees, the Health and Family Services Committee, the Judiciary Committee, and the Rules Committee.
